_readme: Reasoned reconstruction. This workflow depends on TWO RailCall capabilities the original repo diagnosis already flagged as unconfirmed: get_spend_log (reading other workflows' spend) and pause_workflow (pausing a workflow via API). Neither can be validated without access to RailCall's complete admin API documentation (out of scope for this build). See this workflow's README.md.

providers.name: railcall
providers.note: get_spend_log and pause_workflow are this workflow's core, and neither is confirmed. Without them, budget-guardian can't operate autonomously -- see README.md for the fallback plan (manual check and pause).

internal_modules.name: budget-guardian-core
internal_modules.note: Decides WHAT to pause, doesn't execute the pause. Execution depends on the unconfirmed pause_workflow capability.

spend_limits.note: This is the same cap as fika-sync/engine_spec.json — budget-guardian watches the aggregate spend of ALL workflows, not just its own.
